g.text: node m: memory, no leak (a floating gate)
agnd: analogue ground, one buffer for the chip (in SPICE, ground through a 0 V source

svg.text: 8 nodes: each a capacitor to ground, a leak (a resistor to analogue ground), its bias (a current from a rail), the inputs' clamp diodes; the supplies and cascode biases.
This sheet: 8 capacitors, 7 resistors, 6 diodes, 14 sources. Whole circuit: 396 transistors, 48 resistors, 15 capacitors, 6 diodes, 48 sources.
A dot joins wires; wires crossing without one don't connect. A pointed blue label is a node of the top sheet; a plain label joins within this sheet.
Drawn from the netlist minimal/spice.py writes for SPICE, and checked against it: every connection here is the netlist's, and only those.
The body's pulses (vermilion) enter at the sensors and taste; they are the body, not the circuit.
